note: Every external dataset Falakus uses, checked against tools/*.py and web/*.js on branch v11 (2026-11-15). on_challenge_list = named in the 'Dancing with the SARs' resource list. Listed resources we did not use are at the end, marked 'not used'.

datasets.name: NISAR L2 GCOV (Geocoded Polarimetric Covariance)
datasets.band_or_resolution: L-band 24 cm, HH + HV, 20 m grid, 12-day repeat
datasets.role_in_falakus: Core data: every radar map, change detection, water and field classification, the frame browser
datasets.where_in_app: Home map, Explorer, case pages (Andijan, Panama), science panels, history slider

datasets.name: NISAR L2 GUNW (interferogram)
datasets.role_in_falakus: Ground-motion fringes (screening)

datasets.name: NISAR Data User Guide
datasets.role_in_falakus: Product layout, polarisations and calibration notes behind our readers (gcov_science.py, gunw_read.py)

datasets.name: NASA CMR / Earthdata Search
datasets.role_in_falakus: Finds every NISAR pass over a place (both GCOV collections); also ICESat-2 ATL13 granules
datasets.where_in_app: Pass lists, last-look API, case builders

datasets.name: NASA GIBS: NISAR GCOV layer
datasets.band_or_resolution: display-scaled PNG tiles to zoom 13 (~19 m), R=B=HH, G=HV
datasets.role_in_falakus: Fast worldwide NISAR tiles; screening-only change maps; the 2026 'now' frame in then-vs-now
datasets.where_in_app: Home map, Explorer, case pages, history pairs

datasets.name: NASA GIBS: OPERA RTC-S1 layer
datasets.role_in_falakus: C-band radar context layer next to NISAR

datasets.name: NASA GIBS: OPERA DIST-ALERT-HLS
datasets.role_in_falakus: Independent optical check of where land cover changed

datasets.name: NASA GIBS: MODIS / VIIRS layers
datasets.band_or_resolution: 250 m-1 km true colour, snow, land temperature; VIIRS 375 m fire hot spots
datasets.role_in_falakus: Optical and thermal context next to radar (cloud check, fires, snow)
datasets.where_in_app: Home map and Explorer layer list

datasets.name: ICESat-2 ATL13 inland water surface height
datasets.band_or_resolution: 532 nm lidar, ~100 m segments along track
datasets.role_in_falakus: Independent water-LEVEL check for the radar water AREA (Andijan reservoir)

datasets.name: EONET natural events
datasets.role_in_falakus: Tells the map where something is happening right now (floods, fires, storms)
datasets.where_in_app: Home map events, Explorer stops, flood watch

datasets.name: FIRMS active fires (VIIRS 375 m)
datasets.role_in_falakus: Fire context layer

datasets.name: USGS earthquake catalogue
datasets.role_in_falakus: Earthquake markers; dates checked before radar is compared

datasets.name: RADARSAT-1 L1 (open archive, EODMS STAC + S3 COG)
datasets.band_or_resolution: C-band 5.6 cm, HH, 8-100 m depending on beam; uncalibrated DN
datasets.role_in_falakus: The 'then' radar frame: radar-to-radar history against NISAR 2026

datasets.name: Sentinel-1 RTC
datasets.role_in_falakus: Long radar time series and training/transfer data for the water and ship tools

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 L2A
datasets.role_in_falakus: Photo check of radar findings; NDVI/NDWI labels for the ML models; time-lapse frames

datasets.name: Landsat Collection 2 L2
datasets.role_in_falakus: Decades-long optical time-lapse (e.g. Aral open water 1985 vs 2026)

datasets.name: ALOS PALSAR RTC
datasets.role_in_falakus: Earlier L-band baseline for the Andijan reservoir (same band as NISAR)

datasets.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
datasets.role_in_falakus: Masks steep slopes where radar shadow fakes water

datasets.name: ESA WorldCover
datasets.role_in_falakus: Training labels and land-cover masks for the classifiers

datasets.name: JRC Global Surface Water
datasets.role_in_falakus: Permanent-water mask so floods are 'new water' only

datasets.name: ICEYE open data
datasets.role_in_falakus: Sub-metre zoom showing what a NISAR 20 m pixel contains
datasets.where_in_app: Classic map app.html, Fergana 0.5 m view

datasets.name: Population by region (Stat.uz)
datasets.role_in_falakus: How many people depend on the Andijan reservoir valley

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
datasets.role_in_falakus: Search box: place name to map location

datasets.name: Esri basemaps
datasets.role_in_falakus: Dark and satellite basemap under the radar layers

datasets.name: ASF Vertex
datasets.role_in_falakus: Manual scene checks; our ASF search API calls go to the same archive

datasets.name: NASA Intro to SAR / ARSET SAR trainings
datasets.role_in_falakus: Background for the plain-language radar explanations

datasets.name: UAVSAR Postcards
datasets.role_in_falakus: Colour idea only (R HH, G HV, B ratio) for science composites; no UAVSAR data used: no UAVSAR flights over our places

datasets.name: NISAR StoryMaps / Applications white papers
datasets.role_in_falakus: not used directly: read for background on applications (water, agriculture, hazards); no numbers taken from them

datasets.name: RADARSAT Constellation Mission (RCM)
datasets.role_in_falakus: not used: RCM imagery needs an EODMS account and order; RADARSAT-1 open archive covers the history role

datasets.name: CSA SAR Python tutorial
datasets.role_in_falakus: not used directly: our RADARSAT-1 reader (tools/rs1_fetch.py) reads the open COG archive with rasterio instead

datasets.name: SAOCOM
datasets.role_in_falakus: not used: SAOCOM data needs a CONAE catalogue account and approval; we had no access during the hackathon
